verdict.rationale: Undermind's core product is AI-generated analysis inside its workspace. It writes syntheses of ranked papers, answers questions across full-text PDFs (including user-uploaded ones), lets you brainstorm with an AI expert and generate custom tables, asks follow-up questions, and sends role-aware alerts on saved topics. Community users corroborate the ranked, annotated results and the comprehensive topic understanding. Missing for 10: detailed docs on insights drawn from users' own uploaded workspace data (most evidence concerns the global literature), and independent corroboration of the in-product brainstorming and suggestion features.
